nomic-embed-text:latest.name: Search Index
nomic-embed-text:latest.description: Not a chat model — pull this once to power the Reference Library's semantic search (the 📚 toggle in chat, and the Library tab's search). Tiny and fast; works regardless of whatever chat model you actually talk to.

qwen3.8:27b.name: Core Ultra
qwen3.8:27b.description: Same newest-gen model as the 24GB tier — nothing bigger meaningfully beats it while fitting cleanly under 32GB, so the extra headroom goes toward its full 262K native context instead of a bigger, older model. Qwen2.5-32B (the previous pick here) is still a fine fallback if you specifically want more raw parameters over the newer architecture

deepseek-r1:32b.name: Logic Ultra
deepseek-r1:32b.description: Same model as the 24GB tier — nothing bigger (70B-class) fits under 32GB. The payoff here is a much larger KV cache: long chain-of-thought traces and big reasoning contexts no longer get truncated

qwen3-vl:32b.name: Eye Ultra
qwen3-vl:32b.description: Same top-tier vision model as the 24GB tier — the extra 32GB headroom goes toward higher image resolution and multi-image context instead of a larger model, since nothing meaningfully bigger fits safely under 32GB

hf.co/bartowski/cognitivecomputations_Do.name: Unchained Ultra
hf.co/bartowski/cognitivecomputations_Do.description: Dolphin 3.0's reasoning variant — same refusal-free training as the standard Dolphin, plus ~800K reasoning traces bolted on, so it can chain-of-thought its way through complex uncensored requests. 32GB gives it plenty of room for long context. Pull via Ollama's Hugging Face bridge (confirmed bartowski quant repo)

qwen2.5-coder:32b.name: Dev Ultra
qwen2.5-coder:32b.description: 92.7% HumanEval — the strongest dense (non-MoE) open coder that fits a single GPU, with 32GB leaving room for very long context on large codebases

hf.co/bartowski/cognitivecomputations_Do.name: Muse Ultra
hf.co/bartowski/cognitivecomputations_Do.description: Same pick as the 24GB tier — the next credible step up (Llama 3.3 70B-class fiction models) needs ~48GB, so it doesn't fit. Spend the extra 32GB headroom on context length for full chapters instead of a bigger model. Pull via Ollama's Hugging Face bridge (confirmed bartowski quant repo)

qwen3.6:27b.name: Ranger Ultra
qwen3.6:27b.description: Strongest general-knowledge model that fits comfortably under 32GB, with heavy headroom for RAG — load several full PDF reference books (first aid, food preservation, electrical code, homesteading) into context at once for grounded, citable answers. It's still safety-tuned, though: both 24B Dolphin variants are already claimed by Creative and NSFW in this file, so rather than force a third duplicate entry, use Unchained Ultra above (Dolphin3.0-R1-Mistral-24B) directly whenever a question is one this model hedges on
